quality_assessment: Excellent comprehensive troubleshooting guide with minor gaps in diagnostic flag coverage

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention that --debug shows which regex engine was selected (default vs PCRE2)
issues.should_add: Document that --debug outputs include engine selection information, which is useful for troubleshooting regex issues
issues.fix_suggestion: Add bullet point: '- Regex engine selection (default Rust regex vs PCRE2)' to the --debug feature list
issues.source_reference: features.json debugging_troubleshooting.debug_modes.debug.output: 'Search strategy information, engine selection, configuration'

issues.description: Chapter covers --regex-size-limit but doesn't mention the related --dfa-size-limit error
issues.should_add: Document that DFA cache size limit can also be exceeded and can be increased with --dfa-size-limit
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection after 'Compiled regex exceeds size limit' covering DFA size limit errors with --dfa-size-limit solution (default: 1 MB)

issues.description: Stats example mentions 'matched lines' but doesn't clarify this metric only applies with -c/--count mode
issues.current_content: matched lines: Number of lines containing matches (with -c/--count)
issues.should_be: Explanation is present but could be clearer that this metric is only relevant when using count mode
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify that 'matched lines' is primarily relevant when using -c/--count flags, otherwise it tracks lines with matches

issues.section: Ignore File Issues - Diagnosing Ignore Problems
issues.description: Chapter mentions --no-messages for permission errors but doesn't mention --no-ignore-messages for ignore-related messages
issues.should_add: Document --no-ignore-messages flag for suppressing ignore-related error messages specifically
issues.fix_suggestion: Add --no-ignore-messages to the 'Bypassing Ignore Files' section as a way to suppress ignore-related warnings

issues.description: Chapter describes --trace as providing 'Regex matching internals' but it provides general trace-level debug info
issues.current_content:
The `--trace` flag provides even more detailed output than `--debug`, including:

- Regex matching internals
- Low-level search decisions
- Detailed filter processing
issues.should_be: More general description: trace-level debug information covering all aspects of ripgrep's operation
issues.fix_suggestion: Revise description to be more accurate: 'trace-level debug information' rather than focusing only on regex internals

issues.description: The --files flag is mentioned but not emphasized enough as a key diagnostic tool
issues.should_add: Elevate --files flag importance in troubleshooting workflows - it's a primary diagnostic for understanding what will be searched
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding to quick checklist or creating a dedicated subsection showing how to use --files to diagnose filtering issues
issues.source_reference: features.json debugging_troubleshooting.diagnostic_flags.files: '--files (list files that would be searched)'

issues.description: The --type-list flag is mentioned only once but should be more integrated into troubleshooting workflows
issues.should_add: Better integration of --type-list as a diagnostic tool for understanding file type filtering
issues.fix_suggestion: Add example in 'No Results Found' section showing how to use --type-list to check if a file type is recognized
